title: Work in progress: 2D shmup called Hellchain
author: same_vibes
selftext:
Little WIP from this weekend, working the laser beam attacks. Still needs lots of tuning but feeling cool so far!

This is from a retro 2D shoot 'em up I'm building where a core mechanic is to combo elements together to create different attack types. This beam is created with a combo of ice and lightning for example.

  
Power fantasy of the game is that you're Earth's last fighter pilot and last hope, fighting against a demon invasion.

  
Building this with Love2D engine, coding with Cursor.

Pixel art assets are a mix of hand made and some generated with Retro Diffusion and GPT Image.

replies.author: same_vibes
replies.body: Cheers mate! Having fun making this one

comments.author: MikesWorldNYC
comments.body: This is sick. I also started working on a vertical shoot em up, though your art is unique. Did you make it yourself?

replies.author: same_vibes
replies.body:
Cheers, shmup makers unite 😂 feels like a very niche game category these days, but I love making it.

The art assets are a mix. The background art is made with GPT Image. The enemies are all created using RetroDiffusion, using their animation feature. Some of these are still a bit rough and likely I'll do more polish as I go.  


All of the elemental visual effects, projectiles, ship and various UI pieces I made myself.. very slowly 😅 I'm new to pixel art but finding it kinda relaxing to do while Cursor is cooking on code changes.

replies.author: MikesWorldNYC
replies.body:
Gotcha. I use GPT, pixel.io and slowly started trying to learn pixel art myself as well. My game focuses more speed, temp shields, power ups and all out chaotic fun.

It's not a niche genre, it's a genre that's actually generative with our current tools out. I have made a raycaster, a pseudo 3d rpg and a beat em up as well. Some even in C and C++
